title: skills: teach the `positions` column of admin import-users
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: the skills follow-up named at claim time on card #33113 (PR #34531), passed on by area `o2-D`. Dedupe: `import-users positions skill`.

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#33113 给批量导入用户加了 `positions` 列，但教 import-users 的技能文本还没写这一列。
- 需要你做的：无(落地时按受管面照常审批)。

## Change

After PR #34531 merges, add the `positions` column to the skill that teaches import-users: its shape, that each row's user must be a member of the organization, and the error a row gets when it is not. Take the wording from the merged code and docs; do not restate it in a second place.

## Done when

`git grep -n "positions" skills/` shows the column in that skill, and its eval exercises one import with a `positions` column.

Blocked-by: #33113
